mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected corporate cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase capital spending and lift earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, prompting firms to reduce capital expenditures and lower earnings forecasts, which compresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 104.0 signals robust manufacturing activity, prompting optimism about future demand and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in robust periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates weak manufacturing momentum, prompting pessimism about future demand and corporate earnings, which compresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over 3 months signals disinflation, lowering inflation risk premiums and freeing up capital for investment in equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 330.0 triggers a risk-on equity premium as investors anticipate higher inflation and potential rate cuts, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
